## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Nàinǚ Qípó jīng* (T554) is a one-fascicle parallel of [KR6i0184](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0184) (T553), both attributed to Ān Shìgāo. *Nàinǚ* 奈女 = 㮈女 (Āmrapālī, Mango-Maiden); *Qípó* 耆婆 = 祇域 (Jīvaka). The two transliterations of *Jīvaka* differ slightly.

**Abstract**

A parallel recension to [KR6i0184](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0184) of the Āmrapālī-Jīvaka narrative. Translation falls within Ān Shìgāo's productive period (148–170 CE).
